metadata.name: infx_support
metadata.description: INFx direct support: gifts and membership charges, 99.9% to the creator and 0.1% to the treasury in one instruction

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second half: the proposed key takes over and the proposal is closed.

instructions.name: apply_payment_account_rotation
docs: Anyone may apply a rotation once the cooling period has passed; only
the creator's earlier signature decided what it is.

instructions.name: authorize_renewal
docs: Opt-in permission for at most twelve calendar-month renewals. The source
stays member-owned; only this program's PDA can use its allowance.

instructions.name: cancel_admin_transfer
docs: The current admin withdraws a proposal.

instructions.name: cancel_membership
docs: Cancellation prevents future charges and does nothing else.

instructions.name: cancel_payment_account_rotation
docs: The creator can withdraw a pending rotation at any time before it applies,
including while the protocol is paused: cancelling only reduces risk.

instructions.name: charge_membership_period
docs: The member pays one period. Manual in Phase 1: the member signs each
time. A charge cannot exceed the plan price, cannot happen inside the
period, and cannot happen on a closed plan or a paused creator.
Paying again after cancelling is a deliberate act by the member and
re-activates the membership.

instructions.name: charge_renewal
docs: Permissionless submission: caller pays SOL but can only execute the exact
signed mandate. Chain time and account locks prevent early/duplicate charges.

instructions.name: create_membership_plan
docs: A membership plan: a price per period and the hash of the benefits
description shown to members. The hash is a record, not a contract:
INFx does not enforce it (ADR 0007).

instructions.name: gift
docs: A one-off gift. 99.9% to the creator, 0.1% to the treasury, nothing else.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup. Only the program's upgrade authority can call it, so a
fresh deployment cannot be claimed by whoever reaches it first. The
treasury and admin can later be changed by the admin (`set_treasury`,
`propose_admin` then `accept_admin`), which on mainnet is the Squads
multisig.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, so its ProgramData account can be checked.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Only the upgrade authority may initialise.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First half of an admin hand-over. Nothing changes until the proposed
key signs `accept_admin`, so a typo cannot strand the protocol.

instructions.name: register_creator
docs: Registers a verified creator. Both the INFx registrar and the creator
sign: the registrar attests to verification, the creator attests to the
payment account. Neither can do it alone.

instructions.name: request_payment_account_rotation
docs: The creator asks to move where they are paid. It takes effect after the
cooling period, and the pending change is visible on-chain meanwhile.

instructions.name: set_creator_paused
docs: The registrar or the admin can pause a creator: no new gifts or charges.

instructions.name: set_plan_active
docs: Closing a plan stops new charges. Existing members keep what they paid
for; nothing is refunded because nothing is held.

instructions.name: set_plan_benefits_hash
docs: A new benefits description creates a new version. Members keep the hash
they joined under so they can show what was promised when they paid.

instructions.name: set_treasury
docs: Points the fee share at a different USDC account, for example after the
current one is frozen or closed. Every later gift and charge pays it.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorised for this action

errors.name: PriceOutOfRange
errors.msg: Plan price is outside the allowed range

errors.name: PeriodOutOfRange
errors.msg: Plan period is outside the allowed range

errors.name: PlanClosed
errors.msg: Plan is closed to new charges

errors.name: PeriodNotElapsed
errors.msg: The membership period has not elapsed since the last charge

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: Token account is for the wrong mint

errors.name: WrongPaymentAccount
errors.msg: Payment account is not the creator's registered account

errors.name: WrongTreasuryAccount
errors.msg: Treasury account does not match the global configuration

errors.name: PaymentAccountNotOwnedByCreator
errors.msg: Payment account must be owned by the creator

errors.name: PlanCreatorMismatch
errors.msg: Plan does not belong to this creator

errors.name: RotationNotYetEffective
errors.msg: The rotation cooling period has not elapsed

errors.name: InvalidMandate
errors.msg: Renewal permission is inactive or its accepted terms have changed

errors.name: MandateExpired
errors.msg: The renewal retry window has expired; fresh consent is required

errors.name: OtherDelegate
errors.msg: This USDC account already grants permission to another application; revoke it in your wallet first

types.name: AdminTransfer
docs: A pending admin hand-over. Kept in its own PDA so the deployed
`GlobalConfig` layout is unchanged.
